newsitem.title: USA: Forcenergy sees '97 spending of $195 mln.
newsitem.headline: Forcenergy sees '97 spending of $195 mln.

text.p: Forcenergy Inc said Tuesday it plans to spend about $195 million on capital projects during 1997.
Spending excluding acquisitions totaled $130 million last year, spokesman J. Russell Porter said, adding nearly $150 million was spent on acquisitions.

Forcenergy said its preliminary 1997 budget calls for some $160 million to be spent on 28 exploitation/exploration wells and eight development wells on the company's Gulf of Mexico producing properties, $10 million is planned for Gulfcoast onshore drilling activities, $15 million on drilling and workovers on the recently acquired producing properties in the Cook Inlet area, and the balance on international drilling ventures primarily offshore Gabon and Australia.
The 1997 preliminary capital budget does not include acquisitions which will be pursued opportunistically throughout the year, the company pointed out.
